t: Ritika alone can paint (4/5)<sup>th</sup> part of a house in 48 hours while Ravi can paint 1/3<sup>rd</sup> part of the house in 25 hours. If Ravi start painting the house and on every third hour Ritika joined him, then the house will be painted in -
e: Time taken by Ritika alone to paint = 48 * 5/4 = 60 hours Time taken by Ravi alone to paint = 25 * 3/1 = 75 hours Since, Ravi start painting the house and on every third hour Ritika joined him. Then, First two hours work done by Ravi alone = 2/75 Third hour's work done by Ravi and Ritika together = 1/75 + 1/60 = 3/100 Then, first 3 hours work done = 2/75 + 3/100 = 17/300 Therefore, part of work done in (3 * 17 = 51) hours = 17 * 17/300 = 289/300 Remaining work = 1 - 289/300 = 11/300 Now, part of work done by Ravi in next two hours (i.e., 52nd and 53rd hour) = 2/75 Then, remaining work = 11/300 - 2/75 = 1/100 Now, time taken by Ravi and Ritika together to do remaining work = (1/100) * 100/3 = 1/3 hours = 1/3 * 60 = 20 minutes Therefore, total time taken = 51 hours + 2 hours + 20 minutes = 53 hours 20 minutes
h: रितिका अकेले एक घर के (4/5)<sup>वें</sup> भाग को 48 घंटे में पेंट कर सकती है, जबकि रवि घर के 1/3वें भाग को 25 घंटे में पेंट कर सकता है। यदि रवि घर को पेंट करना शुरू करता है और प्रत्येक तीसरे घंटे में रितिका उसके साथ जुड़ जाती है, तो घर कितने समय में पेंट हो जाएगा?

t: A can do 4/5<sup>th</sup> of the work in 48 hours, B can do half of the work in 20 hours while C can do 33(1/3)% of the work in 10 hours. All of them started the work together, A and B left 6 hours and 4 hours before the completion of the work respectively. Find the total time taken to complete the work.
e: 33(1/3) means (33 + 1/3) od (100/3). A = 48 * 5/4 = 60 hours B = 20 * 2 = 40 hours C = 10 * 100/(100/3) = 30 hours A and B left 6 hours and 4 hours before the completion of the work respectively. This means C alone worked for last 4 hours while B and C together worked for 2 hours before that time. So, Part of work done by C in 4 hours = 4/30 = 2/15 Part of work done by B and C together in 2 hours = 2 * (1/30 + 1/40) = 7/60 So, remaining work (which is done by A, B and C together) = 1 - 2/15 - 7/60 = 3/4 Let A, B and C together completed 3/4 part of the work in t hours. Now, t = (3/4) * 1/(1/60 + 1/40 + 1/30) t = (3/4) * 120/9 t = 10 Therefore, total time taken to complete the work = 10 + 2 + 4 = 16 hours
h: A काम का 4/5 भाग को 48 घंटे में कर सकता है, B आधे काम को 20 घंटे में कर सकता है जबकि C काम का 33(1/3)% को 10 घंटे में कर सकता है। उनमें से सभी ने एक साथ काम करना प्रारंभ किया, A और B ने काम पूरा होने से क्रमश: 6 घंटे और 4 घंटे पहले काम को छोड़ दिया, तो काम को पूरा करने में लिया गया कुल समय ज्ञात कीजिए।

t: A work can be completed by 40 workers in 40 days. If 5 workers leave every 10 days then in how many days work will be completed?
e:
Total work = (40 X 40) = 1600 man - days = 1600 MD
Total work done in first 10 days = (10 X 40) = 400 MD
Total work done in next 10 days = (10 X 35) = 350 MD
Total work done in next 10 days = (10 X 30) = 300 MD
Total work done in next 10 days = (10 X 25) = 250 MD
Total work done in next 10 days = (10 X 20) = 200 MD
Total work done after 50 days = (400 + 350 + 300 + 250 + 200)
= 1500 MD
Remaining work = (1600 - 1500) MD = 100 MD
Now number of people still working = 15
Number of days taken to finish the remaining work = 100/15 = (6) (2/3) days
So total number of days taken to complete the work = (50 + (6) (2/3)) days
= (56) (2/3) days
h: एक काम 40 मजदूरों द्वारा 40 दिनों में पूरा किया जा सकता है। यदि हर 10 दिन में 5 मजदूर काम छोड़ दें तो काम कितने दिनों में पूरा होगा?

t: Three workers A, B, and C can complete a job in 18, 24, and 36 days respectively. They start together but B leaves after 4 days, and A leaves 3 days after B. C finishes the remaining work in 9 days. In how many days can A, B, and C together complete the job?
e:
Let rA = rate of A = 1/18 job/day
Let rB = rate of B = 1/24 job/day
Let rC = rate of C = 1/36 job/day
Total work W = 1 job
Work done in first 4 days by A + B + C = 4(rA + rB + rC)
rA + rB + rC = 1/18 + 1/24 + 1/36 = common denom 72: 4/72 + 3/72 + 2/72 = 9/72 = 1/8
W1 = 4 X (1/8) = 1/2 job
Remaining = 1/2 job
After B leaves, A + C work 3 more days:
rA + rC = 1/18 + 1/36 = (2/36 + 1/36) = 3/36 = 1/12 job/day
W2 = 3 X (1/12) = 1/4 job
Remaining = 1/2 - 1/4 = 1/4 job
C alone finishes 1/4 job in 9 days: 9 X (1/36) = 9/36 = 1/4 job (consistent)
All three together have combined rate = 1/8 job/day
Time to finish W = 1 / (1/8) = 8 days
h: तीन मज़दूर A, B और C एक काम को क्रमशः 18, 24 और 36 दिनों में पूरा कर सकते हैं। वे साथ मिलकर काम शुरू करते हैं, लेकिन B, 4 दिन बाद काम छोड़ देता है और A, B के 3 दिन बाद काम छोड़ देता है। C शेष काम 9 दिनों में पूरा करता है। A, B और C मिलकर काम कितने दिनों में पूरा कर सकते हैं?

t: Achinta, Bobby, Cindrella working together completed a job in 10 days. However, Cindrella only worked for the first three days when 0.37 part of the job was done. Also, the work done by Achinta in 5 days is equal to the work done by Bobby in four days. How many days would be required by the fastest worker to complete the entire work?
e:
The equations are:
3 (A + B + C) = 37% of the work.
7 (A + B) = 63% of the work.
So, A + B = 9% of the work --- (1)
Where A, B, C are one day's work of Achinta, Bobby and Cindrella respectively.
Further 5A = 4B --- (2)
From (1) and (2), A = 4% of the work and B = 5% of the work
In 3 days (A + B + C) do 37% of the work.
Out of that, A + B do 9% each day.
Hence, in three days, (A + B) X 3 = 27% of the work.
Remaining work in first three days = 37 - 27 = 10% of the work
So, Cindrella would do 3.33% of the work in a day.
Thus Bobby is the fastest and he would complete it in 20 days.
h: अचिनता, बॉबी, सिंड्रेला एक साथ मिलकर 10 दिनों में एक कार्य को पूरा करते हैं। हालांकि, सिंड्रेला ने केवल पहले तीन दिनों के लिए काम किया जब कार्य का 0.37 हिस्सा हो चुका था।साथ ही अचिनता द्वारा 5 दिनों में किया गया कार्य बॉबी द्वारा चार दिनों में किए गए कार्य के बराबर है। पूरे कार्य को पूरा करने के लिए सबसे तेज़ कार्यकर्ता को कितने दिनों की आवश्यकता होगी?

t: A and B together can complete a task in 20 days, and B and C together can complete the same task in 30 days. If A alone takes half as many days as C alone to complete the task, how long will A, B, and C working together take to complete the task?
e:
Let rA, rB, rC be rates (job/day). Given:
rA + rB = 1/20 .. (1)
rB + rC = 1/30 .. (2)
A alone takes half as many days as C alone → tA = 0.5 tC → 1/rA = 0.5(1/rC) → rA = 2rC .. (3)
Substitute (3) into (1): 2rC + rB = 1/20 → rB = 1/20 - 2rC .. (4)
Substitute (4) into (2): (1/20 - 2rC) + rC = 1/30 → 1/20 - rC = 1/30
→ - rC = 1/30 - 1/20 = (2 - 3)/60 = - 1/60 → rC = 1/60 job/day
Step 3: rA = 2rC = 2/60 = 1/30 job/day
rB = 1/20 - 2(1/60) = 3/60 - 2/60 = 1/60 job/day
Combined rate = rA + rB + rC = 1/30 + 1/60 + 1/60 = (2 + 1 + 1)/60 = 4/60 = 1/15 job/day
Time = 1 ÷ (1/15) = 15 days
h: A और B मिलकर एक काम 20 दिनों में पूरा कर सकते हैं, और B और C मिलकर उसी काम को 30 दिनों में पूरा कर सकते हैं। यदि A अकेले काम पूरा करने में C से आधे दिन लेता है, तो A, B और C मिलकर काम पूरा करने में कितना समय लेंगे?

t: A and B can do a work alone in 40 days and 60 days respectively. They started the work together and B left 10 days before the completion of work. For how many days did B work?
e: No. of days in which A can do the work alone = 40 days No. of days in which B can do the work alone = 60 days When A and B started the work together, B left 10 days before the completion of work. This means A alone worked for last 10 days. So, Part of work done by A in last 10 days = 10/40 = 1/4 Remaining work = 1 - 1/4 = 3/4 Now, time taken by A and B together to complete 3/4th part of the work = (3/4) * 1/(1/40 + 60) = (3/4) * 1/((3 + 2)/120) = (3/4) * 120/5 = 18 Therefore, B worked for 18 days.
h: A और B अकेले किसी काम को क्रमश: 40 दिन और 60 दिन में पूरा कर सकते हैं। उन्होंने एक साथ काम शुरू किया और B ने काम पूरा होने से 10 दिन पहले काम छोड़ दिया। B ने कितने दिनों तक काम किया?

t: 25 men completely build a wall working for 40 days. After working for 24 days 35 more men joined the workers. Now remaining portion of the wall will be built in how many days?
e:
According to the question 25 men can complete the work in 40 days hence amount of work done by 1 man in one day = 1/((25 X 40) )=1/1000
Total amount of work done in 24 days = (25 X 24)/1000=3/5
Now remaining work = 1- 3/5=2/5
Now total number of people working to build a wall = (25 + 35) = 60
Let's suppose they will take 'N' days to complete the remaining work. Therefore: 1/1000 X 60 X N=2/5
=> N=(2 X 1000)/(5 X 60)
=> N=6 2/3 Days
So, remaining work will be completed in 6(2/3) Days.

t: A alone can do work in 48 days and ratio of efficiency of A to B is 4: 3. They together start working on a work and work for 6 days after another person C joins them and together they finish the remaining work in 10 more days. If they undertook to do the work for Rs.5250, then what is the share of B?
e:
Time taken by A alone to do the work = 48 days
Time taken by B alone to do the work = 48 * (4/3) = 64 days
Total days for which A and B work = 6 + 10 = 16 days
According to the question-
(16/48) + (16/64) + (10/C) = 1
(10/C) = 1 - (1/3) - (1/4)
(10/C) = (5/12)
C = 24 days
Part of work done by A = (16/48) = 1/3
Part of work done by B = (16/64) = 1/4
Part of work done by C = (10/24) = 5/12
Ratio of their work done = (1/3): (1/4): (5/12) = 4: 3: 5
Share of B = 5250 * (3/12) = Rs.1312.5

t: A can do a piece of work in 30 days, B in 50 days and C in 40 days. If A is assisted by B on one day and by C on the next day alternately, the work will be completed in:
e:
Total work = LCM of 30, 50, and 40 = 600
A's one day work = 600/30 = 20
B's one day work = 600/50 = 12
C's one day work = 600/40 = 15
Total one day work when A and B together works = 20 + 12 = 32
Total one day work when A and C together works = 20 + 15 = 35
Total 2 days work = 32 + 35 = 67
Total work in 16 days = (67/2) * 16 = 536
Total work in 17 days = 536 + 32 = 568
Remaining work = 600 - 568 = 32
Hence, total time taken to finish the work = 17 + (32/35) = 17(32/35) days
h: A एक कार्य को 30 दिनों में पूरा कर सकता है, B कार्य को 50 दिनों में पूरा कर सकता है और C कार्य को 40 दिनों में पूरा कर सकता है। यदि A के साथ एक दिन B और अगले दिन C एकांतर रूप से कार्य करते हैं, तो कार्य ______ में पूरा हो जायेगा।

t: 6 men and 8 women can do a piece of work in 10 days, whereas 26 man and 48 women can so the same work in 2 days. What will be the time taken by 15 men and 20 women to do the same work?
e:
Let work done by 1 man in 1 day = m and work done by 1 woman in 1 day = b
Work done by 6 men and 8 women in 1 day = 1/10
=> 6m + 8b = 1/10
=> 60m + 80b = 1 ---(1)
Work done by 26 men and 48 women in 1 day = 1/2
=> 26m + 48b =1/2
=> 52m + 96b = 1 ---(2)
Solving equation 1 and equation 2. We get m = 1/100 and b = 1/200
Work done by 15 men and 20 women in 1 day.
= 15/100 + 20/200 =1/4
=> Time taken by 15 men and 20 women in doing the work = 4 days
h: 6 पुरुष और 8 महिलाएँ किसी कार्य को 10 दिनों में कर सकते हैं, जबकि 26 पुरुष और 48 महिलाएँ समान कार्य को 2 दिनों में कर सकते हैं। 15 पुरुषों और 20 महिलाओं द्वारा समान कार्य को करने में कितना समय लगेगा?

t: A and B together can do a piece of work in 14 days, B and C together can do the same piece of work in 20 days and C and A together can do the same piece of work in 15 days. They all work together for 10 days after which A and B leave the work. How many days C will take to finish the remaining work?
e:
Let total work = LCM of 14, 20, and 15 = 420 units
Efficiency of A and B = 420/14 = 30 units per day
Efficiency of B and C = 420/20 = 21 units per day
Efficiency of C and A = 420/15 = 28 units per day
2 * (A + B + C) = 79
A + B + C = 79/2
Efficiency of C = (79/2) - 30 = 19/2 units per day
Work done by A, B, and C in 10 days = 79 * 10/2 = 395
Remaining work = 420 - 395 = 25 units
Required number of days = 25 * 2/19 = 50/19 = 2(12/19) days.
h: एक साथ A और B एक कार्य को 14 दिनों में कर सकते हैं, एक साथ B और C समान कार्य को 20 दिनों में कर सकते हैं तथा एक साथ C और A समान कार्य को 15 दिनों में कर सकते हैं। वे सभी 10 दिनों तक एक साथ कार्य करते हैं जिसके बाद A और B कार्य छोड़ देते हैं। शेष कार्य को पूरा करने में C को कितने दिन लगेंगे?

t: P can do a certain work in 36 days and Q and R together can do the same work in 20 days. If Q can do the same work in 2.5 times the number of days in which P and R together can do, find the number of days taken by R alone to complete the same work.
e:
Let total work = LCM of 36 and 20 = 180 units
Efficiency of P = 180/36 = 5 units per day
Efficiency of Q and R = 180/20 = 9 units per day
Efficiency of P, Q, and R together = 14 units per day
Ratio of number of days taken by Q and (P + R) = 2.5: 1 = 5: 2
Ratio of efficiencies of Q and (P + R) = 2: 5
So,
Q + P + R = 14
7x = 14
x = 2
Efficiency of P + R = 5x = 10
Efficiency of R = 10 - 5 = 5 units per day
Required answer = 180/5 = 36 days
h: P एक निश्चित कार्य को 36 दिनों में कर सकता है तथा एक साथ Q और R समान कार्य को 20 दिनों में कर सकते हैं। यदि Q समान कार्य को एक साथ P और R द्वारा कार्य को पूरा करने में लिए गये दिनों की संख्या के 2.5 गुना दिनों में कर सकता है, तो R द्वारा अकेले समान कार्य को पूरा करने में लिए गये दिनों की संख्या ज्ञात कीजिये।

t: Prakash's 5 day's work is equal to Suresh's 3 day's work and ratio of efficiency of Suresh to Krishna is 4: 3. Suresh and Krishna started working together and worked for 4 days. After that Krishna left the work and Prakash joined Suresh and they together worked for next 5 days. Now Suresh left the work and Prakash alone finished the remaining work in 5 more day. Find that in how many days Suresh can finish the work alone?
e:
Prakash's 5 day's work is equal to Suresh's 3 day's work. So ratio of their efficiency = 1/5 ∶1/3 = 3 : 5
Ratio of efficiency of Suresh to Krishna = 4 : 3
The ratio of efficiency of Prakash, Suresh and Krishna = 12 : 20 : 15
Let 1 day of work of Prakash, Suresh and Krishan is 12x, 20x and 15x respectively.
Total work = (20x + 15x) * 4 + (12x + 20x) * 5 + 12x * 5 = 360x
Time taken by Suresh alone to finish the work = 360x/20x = 18 days
h: प्रकाश का 5 दिन का कार्य, सुरेश के 3 दिन के कार्य के बराबर है तथा सुरेश की कार्य क्षमता और कृष्णा की कार्य क्षमता का अनुपात 4: 3 है। सुरेश और कृष्णा एक साथ कार्य करना शुरू करते हैं और 4 दिनों तक कार्य करते हैं। उसके बाद कृष्णा कार्य छोड़ देता है और प्रकाश, सुरेश के साथ कार्य में शामिल हो जाता है तथा एक साथ वे अगले 5 दिनों तक कार्य करते हैं। अब सुरेश कार्य छोड़ देता है और प्रकाश अकेले शेष कार्य को अतिरिक्त 5 दिनों में समाप्त करता है, तो ज्ञात कीजिए कि अकेले सुरेश कार्य को कितने दिनों में समाप्त कर सकता है?

t: A can do 4/5 of a piece of work in 20 days, B can do 30% of the same work in 36 days, while C can do 80% of the same work in 160 days. B and C together started and worked for x days. After x days B left the work, and A joined C and both completed the remaining work in (x - 41) days. If the ratio between the work done by (B + C) together to the work done by (A + C) together is 19 : 6, then what fraction of the same work can be completed by C alone in 2x days?
e: A complete the work in = 5/4 * 20 = 25 days. B can complete the work in = 10/3 * 36 = 120 days. C can complete the work in = 5/4 * 160 = 200 days. Total Work LCM = 600. Eff: A=24, B=5, C=3. x days work of (B+C) = (5+3)x = 8x. (x-41) days work of (A+C) = (24+3)(x-41) = 27(x-41). Ratio: 8x / 27(x-41) = 19/6. Solving x = 57. C alone will complete the following work in 2*57 days = 3 * 2 * 57 = 342. Fraction of work = 342/600 = 57/100
h: A एक काम का 4/5 भाग 20 दिनों में कर सकता है, B उसी काम का 30% भाग 36 दिनों में कर सकता है, जबकि C उसी काम का 80% भाग 160 दिनों में कर सकता है। B और C ने एक साथ काम शुरू किया और x दिनों तक काम किया। x दिनों के बाद B ने काम छोड़ दिया, और A, C में शामिल हो गया और दोनों ने शेष कार्य (x - 41) दिनों में पूरा किया। यदि (B + C) द्वारा एक साथ किए गए कार्य और (A + C) द्वारा एक साथ किए गए कार्य के बीच का अनुपात 19 : 6 है, तो उसी कार्य का कितना भाग C अकेले 2x दिनों में पूरा कर सकता है?

t: Jiya, Riya, and Kiya took a work in Rs. 1848 and completed it together in 15 days. If Riya is 75% more efficient than Kiya and Kiya and Jiya together can complete the same work in 40 days, then what is the difference between the share of Jiya and Kiya?
e:
Riya alone can complete the whole work in = 1/(1/15 - 1/40) = 24 days
So, Kiya alone can complete the whole work in = 24 * 175/100 = 42 days
And Jiya alone can complete the whole work in = 1/(1/40 - 1/42) = 840 days
Ratio of efficiency of Jiya, Riya, and Kiya = 1/840: 1/24: 1/42 = 1: 35: 20
Hence, difference between the share of Jiya and Kiya = (20 - 1)/(1 + 35 + 20) * 1848 = (19/ 56)* 1848 = 19 * 33 = Rs. 627
h: जिया, रिया और किया ने एक कार्य को 1848 रुपये में लिया और इसे 15 दिनों में एक साथ पूरा किया। यदि रिया, किया की तुलना में 75% अधिक कार्य कुशल है तथा एक साथ किया और जिया समान कार्य को 40 दिनों में पूरा कर सकते हैं, तो जिया और किया के हिस्से के बीच का अंतर कितना है?

t:
A and B together can complete a work in 6 hours and 40 minutes, while B alone can complete the work in 12 hours. If they completed work together for Rs.11016, then which of the following statements is/are true?
(P) The share of B is Rs.210 more than Rs.6000.
(Q) The share of B is Rs.120 more than Rs.6000.
e:
The time taken by A and B together to complete the work = 6 hours and 40 minutes = 6(2/3) hours
The time taken by B alone to complete the work = 12 hours
Now,
(1/A) = (3/20) - (1/12) = 1/15
So, the time taken by A alone to complete the work = 15 hours
The ratio of the efficiencies of A and B = 12: 15 = 4: 5
So, the share of B = 11016 X 5/9 = Rs.6120
Hence, only statement Q is true as 6000 + 120 = Rs.6120
h:
एक साथ A और B किसी काम को 6 घंटे और 40 मिनट में पूरा कर सकते हैं, जबकि अकेले B समान काम को 12 घंटे में पूरा कर सकता है। यदि वे एक साथ 11016 रुपये में काम पूरा करते हैं, तो निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा/से कथन सत्य है/हैं?
(P) B का हिस्सा 6000 रुपये से 210 रुपये अधिक है।
(Q) B का हिस्सा 6000 रुपये से 120 रुपये अधिक है।

t: A contractor takes a contract to complete a road in 120 days and employed 100 labours. After 45 days he found that one fourth work is completed. How many more labours he requires to complete the remaining work in time?
e:
In 45 days 100 labours have done one fourth work, we need to find the labours required for doing three fourth work in given time i.e. 120 - 45 = 75 days
Using formula, M1D1/W1= M2D2/W2
Here M<sub>1</sub>=100, D<sub>1</sub>=45, W<sub>1</sub>= ¼
M<sub>2</sub>=?, D<sub>2</sub>= 75, W<sub>2</sub>= ¾
We have (100 X 45 )/(1/4)= (M2 X 75)/(3/4)
=> M<sub>2</sub>= 180
Now as 100 labours are appointed before therefore extra labours required to complete the work in given time = 80
h: एक ठेकेदार एक सड़क को 120 दिनों में पूरा करने का ठेका लेता है और 100 मजदूरों को नियुक्त करता है। 45 दिनों के बाद उसने पाया कि एक चौथाई काम ही पूरा हो गया है। शेष कार्य को समय पर पूरा करने के लिए उसे और कितने मजदूरों की आवश्यकता होगी?

t: 3 men and 4 women can construct a road in 60 days while 10 men and 12 boys can construct 75% of the road in 18 days. It will take how much time to 4 men, 2 women and 3 boys to construct the complete road?
e:
Let one man, one woman and one boy can construct the road in m days, w days and b days respectively.
3/m + 4/w = 1/60..(i)
10/m + 12/b = 1/((100/75) * 18))
10/m + 12/b = 1/24..(ii)
By taking 2(i) + (ii), we get
6/m + 8/w + 10/m + 12/b = 2/60 + 1/24
16/m + 8/w + 12/b = 1/30 + 1/24
4/m + 2/w + 3/b = 3/160
So, 4 men, 2 women and 3 boys can together construct the complete road in 160/3 days.
h: 3 पुरुष और 4 महिलाएं 60 दिनों में सड़क का निर्माण कर सकते हैं जबकि 10 पुरुष और 12 लड़के 18 दिनों में 75% सड़क का निर्माण कर सकते हैं। 4 पुरुषों, 2 महिलाओं और 3 लड़कों को पूरी सड़क का निर्माण करने में कितना समय लगेगा?

t: A works alone for 't' days on a job, which he can finish in 24 days. After that B, who can finish in 48 days and C, who can finish in 60 days join him, and all three together take 8 more days to finish. Find the value of 't'.
e: Let total work be LCM (24, 48, 60) = 240 units. Efficiency of A = 240/24 = 10 units/day, Efficiency of B = 240/48 = 5 units/day, Efficiency of C = 240/60 = 4 units/day. When B and C join A, their combined efficiency = 10 + 5 + 4 = 19 units/day. Work done together in 8 days = 19 X 8 = 152 units. Work done by A alone = 240 - 152 = 88 units. Time A worked alone (t) = 88 / 10 = 8.8 days.
h: A अकेले 't' दिनों तक एक काम करता है, जिसे वह 24 दिनों में पूरा कर सकता है। उसके बाद B, जो 48 दिनों में पूरा कर सकता है और C, जो 60 दिनों में पूरा कर सकता है, उसके साथ जुड़ जाते हैं, और तीनों मिलकर काम पूरा करने में 8 दिन और लगाते हैं। 't' का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।

t: To do a certain work, A and B work on alternate days with B beginning the work on the first day. A alone can complete the same work in 24 days. If the work gets completed in 11 1/3 days, then B alone can complete 7/9 th part of the original work in:
e: A can complete the total work in 24 days. B & A worked alternatively beginning with B in 11 1/3 days means, B works for 6 days and A work for 5 1/3 days. Let total work = 24 units. Work done by A in 5 1/3 days = 16/3. Remaining work done by B in 6 days. One day work of B = (56/3)/6 = 56/18 units. B will take time to complete the 7/9 of the total work = 24 * (7/9) / (56/18) = 6 days.
h: एक निश्चित कार्य करने के लिए, A और B वैकल्पिक दिन पर कार्य करते हैं, पहले दिन B कार्य शुरू करता है। अकेले A उस कार्य को 24 दिन में कर सकता है। यदि कार्य 11 1/3 दिन में पूरा होता है, तो अकेले B कुल कार्य का 7/9 भाग कितने दिन में पूरा कर सकता है?

t: A can complete a work in 11(1/2) days. B is 25% more efficient than A and C's efficiency is 50% that of B. Working together A, B and C will complete the same work in:
e: Time taken by A alone to complete the work = Ratio of efficiency of A to B = 100: 125 = 4: 5 Ratio of efficiency of B to C = 2: 1 Ratio of efficiency of A, B, and C = (4 * 2): (5 * 2): (5 * 1) = 8: 10: 5 Ratio of time taken by A, B, and C = Time taken by B alone to finish the work = Time taken by C alone to finish the work = Time taken by A, B, and C together to finish the work
h: A किसी कार्य को 11(1/2) दिनों में पूरा कर सकता है। B, A की तुलना में 25% अधिक दक्ष है और C की दक्षता B की दक्षता का 50% भाग है। एक साथ कार्य करते हुए A, B और C समान कार्य को कितने समय में पूरा करेंगे?

t: A and B complete a work in 24 and 30 days, respectively, working 10 hours per day. The work is to be done in two shifts. The morning shift is for 6 hours and the evening shift is for 4 hours. On the first day, A works in the morning and B works in the evening, and they interchange their shifts every day. On which day did the work get completed?
e: Ratio of time taken by A and B = 24 : 30= 4 : 5 Ration of Efficiency of A and B = 5 : 4 Total work =5 × 24 × 10 =1200 Work done on 1st day = 5 × 6 + 4 × 4 = 46 Work done on 2nd day = 4 × 6 + 5 × 4 = 44 Total work completed in 2 days = 90 So, 90 unit work = 2 days 1170 unit work = 26 days 1200 unit work = 26 + = days Therefore work will be completed on 27th day.
h: A और B एक काम को क्रमशः 24 और 30 दिनों में पूरा करते हैं, प्रतिदिन 10 घंटे काम करते हैं। काम दो शिफ्ट में किया जाना है। सुबह की शिफ्ट 6 घंटे की है और शाम की शिफ्ट 4 घंटे की है। पहले दिन, A सुबह काम करता है और B शाम को काम करता है, और वे हर दिन अपनी शिफ्ट बदलते हैं। किस दिन काम पूरा हुआ?
eh: A और B द्वारा लिए गए समय का अनुपात = 24 : 30 = 4 : 5 A और B की कार्यकुशलता का अनुपात = 5 : 4 कुल कार्य = 5 × 24 × 10 = 1200 पहले दिन किया गया कार्य = 5 × 6 + 4 × 4 = 46 दूसरे दिन किया गया कार्य = 4 × 6 + 5 × 4 = 44 2 दिनों में पूरा किया गया कुल कार्य = 90 इसलिए, 90 इकाई कार्य = 2 दिन 1170 इकाई कार्य = 26 दिन 1200 इकाई कार्य = 26+ = दिन इसलिए कार्य 27वें दिन पूरा होगा।

t: 8 men and 12 women can do a work together in 50/9 days while 4 men and 8 children can do the same work together in 12.5 days. If a child can do the whole work alone in 200 days, then in how much time will 2 men, 3 women and 2 children complete the whole work?
e: Time take by one child alone = 200 days Let time taken by one man and one woman alone are 'm' days and 'w' days respectively. Then, (4/m) + (8/200) = 1/12.5 m = 100 days And, (8/m) + (12/w) = 9/50 (8/100) + (12/w) = 9/50 w = 120 days Therefore, time taken by 2 men, 3 women and 2 children to complete the whole work = 1/((2/100) + (3/120) + (2/200)) = 18(2/11) days
h: एक साथ 8 पुरुष और 12 महिलाएँ किसी कार्य को 50/9 दिनों में कर सकते हैं, जबकि एक साथ 4 पुरुष और 8 बच्चे समान कार्य को 12.5 दिनों में कर सकते हैं। यदि एक बच्चा 200 दिनों में पूरे कार्य को अकेले कर सकता है, तो 2 पुरुष, 3 महिलाएँ और 2 बच्चे पूरे कार्य को कितने समय में पूरा करेंगे?

t: C and A together can complete a piece of work in 15 days. B alone can complete it in 30 days. If the work done by C in one day is equal to the work done by A and B together in 1 day. In how many days C alone can complete the same piece of work?
e:
According to question,
C's efficiency = (A + B)'s efficiency.......... (i)
Total work = LCM of 15 and 30 = 30 unit
Efficiency of B = 30/30 = 1 unit
Efficiency of (A + C) = 30/15 = 2 unit
Efficiency of (A + B + C) = 3 unit........ (ii)
Or 2 C's efficiency = 3 unit
C's efficiency = 1.5 unit
Time taken by C alone to complete the whole work = 30/1.5 = 20 days
h: एक साथ C और A किसी कार्य को 15 दिनों में पूरा कर सकते हैं। अकेले B इसे 30 दिनों में पूरा कर सकता है। यदि C द्वारा एक दिन में किया गया कार्य एक साथ A और B द्वारा एक दिन में किये गये कार्य के बराबर है। अकेले C समान कार्य को कितने दिनों में पूरा कर सकता है?

t: In a relief camp there are 100 people and 1500 kg of grain is sufficient for them for 25 days. After 10 days 50 more man came in the camp for shelter. If now all the people have reduced their daily consumption of food by 1/4<sup>th</sup> then how many days food will last in the camp?
e:
Amount of grain remaining in the camp after
10 days = [1500 - (10/25 X 1500)] kg
=900 kg
Daily consumption of grain by one man = 1500/((100 X 25))=3/5 kg
Now total consumption of grain by 150 people
in one day = (150 X 3/5 X 3/4) kg
Let's assume that now remaining grain will last for 'd' days;
Hence; 150 X 3/5 X 3/4 X d=900
=> d= (13) (1/3) Days
h: एक राहत शिविर में 100 लोग हैं और 1500 किलोग्राम अनाज उनके लिए 25 दिनों के लिए पर्याप्त है। 10 दिनों के बाद शिविर में 50 और लोग आश्रय के लिए आ गए। यदि अब सभी लोगों ने अपने दैनिक भोजन की खपत को 1/4<sup>th</sup> तक कम कर दिया है, तो शिविर में भोजन कितने दिनों तक चलेगा?

t: A and B together can do work in 22.8 days. When A work for first 8 days, then the remaining work completed by B in 45 days. If C is 5% less efficient that B, then in how many days will C alone complete the whole work?
e: Here, (1/A) + (1/B) = 1/22.8 8 days' work done by A alone = 8/A Remaining work = 1 - 8/A = (A - 8)/A And, 45 = ((A - 8)/A) * B B = 45A/(A - 8) Now, (1/A) + (1/(45A/(A - 8))) = 1/22.8 A = 38 days And, B = 45 * 38/(38 - 8) = 57 days Efficiency ratio, C: B = 95/100 = 19: 20 Time ratio, C: B = 20: 19 Then, C = 20B/19 = 20 * 57/19 C = 60 days
h: एक साथ A और B, 22.8 दिनों में काम कर सकते हैं। जब A पहले 8 दिनों के लिए काम करता है, तब B शेष कार्य 45 दिनों में पूरा करता है। यदि C, B की तुलना में 5% कम कुशल है, तो C कितने दिनों में अकेले पूरा काम पूर्ण कर सकता है?

t: A can complete a certain work in 36 days. B is % less efficient than A and C is 50% less efficient than B. All the three started the work together, but A left 9 days after the start of the work and B left 3 days before the completion of the work. In how many days was the whole work completed?
e: Ratio of efficiency = A : B : C = 3 : 2 : 1 A can do complete work in 36 days So, total work = 36 × 3 = 108 They together work for 9 days =9 × 6 = 54 C work alone for last 3 days =3 × 1= 3 Therefore remaining work will be done by B and C together Time taken by B + C = = =17 days So, Total days =17 + 3 + 9 = 29 days
h: A किसी काम को 36 दिनों में पूरा कर सकता है। B, A से % कम कुशल है और C, B से 50% कम कुशल है। तीनों ने मिलकर काम शुरू किया, लेकिन A ने काम शुरू होने के 9 दिन बाद काम छोड़ दिया और B ने काम पूरा होने से 3 दिन पहले काम छोड़ दिया। पूरा काम कितने दिनों में पूरा हुआ?
eh: दक्षता का अनुपात = A : B : C = 3 : 2 : 1 A पूरा काम 36 दिन में कर सकता है इसलिए, कुल काम = 36 × 3 = 108 वे साथ मिलकर 9 दिन काम करते हैं =9 × 6 = 54 C अकेले आखिरी 3 दिन काम करता है =3 × 1= 3 इसलिए बचा हुआ काम B और C मिलकर करेंगे B + C द्वारा लिया गया समय = = =17 दिन इसलिए, कुल दिन =17 + 3 + 9 = 29 दिन

t: Ashu can do a piece of work in 40 days. He completed 5/8 of the work and then left it. Shweta can complete the remaining work in 18 days. If they work together they will complete 110% of the same work in-
e:
Part of work done by shweta in 18 days= 3/8
So, whole work can be completed by shweta in 18 x 8/3 = 48 days
Let total work = LCM of 40 and 48 = 240 units
Efficiency of Ashu = 240/40 = 6 units per day
Efficiency of Shweta = 240/48 = 5 units per day
Together they will complete 110% of 240 in [240* (110/100)]/11 = 24 days
h: आशु एक काम को 40 दिनों में कर सकता है। उसने काम का 5/8 भाग पूरा किया और फिर छोड़ दिया। श्वेता शेष काम को 18 दिनों में पूरा कर सकती है। यदि वे एक साथ काम करते हैं तो वे समान काम का 110% कितने दिनों में पूरा करेंगे?

t: Ravi and Sanju together can do a job in 2 days, Sanju and Mahesh can do it in 4 days, while Ravi and Mahesh can do it in 2 days. What is the number of days required for Ravi to do the same job alone?
e:
Total work = LCM of 2, 4 and 2 = 4 units
Efficiency of Ravi + Sanju = 4/2 = 2 ----(1)
Efficiency of Mahesh + Sanju = 4/4 = 1 ----(2)
Efficiency of Ravi + Mahesh = 4/2 = 2 ------(3)
eqn (1) + eqn(3) - eqn(2):
2 * Efficiency of Ravi = 2 + 2 - 1 = 3
Efficiency of Ravi = 3/2
Time taken by Ravi = 4/(3/2) = 8/3 days

t: Two men together can complete a piece of work in 12 days. If after 4 days two more men joins them, the work will now be completed in:
e: Work done by 1 man in one day = 1/(2 X 12) = 1/24 Work completed by 2 men in 4 days = 4 X (1/12) = 1/3 Remaining work = [1 - (1/3)] = 2/3 Work done by 4 men in one day = 4 X (1/24) = 1/6 Time taken by 4 men to complete the remaining work = Time taken to complete the entire work = 4 + 4 = 8 days

t: Sam completed a work in 36 days and Veer is 80% more efficient than Sam. They start working together, but Veer left the work after 9 days due to some issue, then Sam alone can complete the remaining work in:
e:
Sam alone completed the work in 36 days.
Thus, Veer alone completed the work in = 36 * 100/180 = 20 days
In 9 days, part of work done by Sam and Veer = 9 * (1/36 + 1/20) = 7/10
So, remaining work = 1 - 7/10 = 3/10
Hence, Sam alone can complete the remaining work in = 3/10 * 36 = 10.8 days
h: सैम एक कार्य को 36 दिनों में पूरा करता है तथा वीर, सैम से 80% अधिक कार्य कुशल है। वे एक साथ कार्य शुरू करते हैं, लेकिन वीर 9 दिनों के बाद किसी समस्या के कारण कार्य छोड़ देता है, तो सैम अकेले शेष कार्य को कितने दिनों में पूरा कर सकता है?

t: A and B can do a job in 20 days and 30 days respectively. They work together for 6 days, then C; who alone takes 60 days to complete the job joins them. How many more days are needed to finish the work?
e:
Total Work = L.C.M of 20, 30 and 60 = 60 Units
Efficiency of A = 60/20 = 3 Units/day
Efficiency of B = 60/30 = 2 Units/day
Efficiency of C = 60/60 = 1 Units/day
Total Work done A and B in 6days = (3 + 2)* 6 = 30 Units
Remaining = 30 units
With C, days needed= 30/(3+2+1) = 30/6 = 5 days
h: A और B एक काम को क्रमशः 20 दिन और 30 दिन में पूरा कर सकते हैं। वे 6 दिन साथ मिलकर काम करते हैं, फिर C, जो अकेले काम पूरा करने में 60 दिन लगाता है, उनके साथ जुड़ जाता है। काम पूरा करने के लिए उन्हें और कितने दिन चाहिए?

t: Amit can finish the work in 15 days, and Baban can finish the same work in 25 days. They work together for 5 days. The rest of the work was finished by Amit and Chetan in 4 days. How much time is required for Chetan to finish this work?
e: Efficiency of Amit and Baban 5,3 respectively In 8 days work done = 8×5 = 40 units Remaining work = (75-40) = 35 units Amit + Chetan do remaining work in 4 days = 35/4 = 8 3/4 efficiency of Chetan = 3 (3/4) = 15/4 Time taken by Chetan to complete the work = 75/(15/4) = 20 days
h: अमित किसी काम को 15 दिनों में पूरा कर सकता है, और बबन उसी काम को 25 दिनों में पूरा कर सकता है। वे दोनों मिलकर 5 दिनों तक काम करते हैं। बचा हुआ काम अमित और चेतन ने मिलकर 4 दिनों में पूरा किया। चेतन को यह काम पूरा करने में कितना समय लगेगा?
eh: अमित और बबन की कार्यक्षमता क्रमशः 5 और 3 है। 8 दिनों में किया गया कार्य = 8×5 = 40 यूनिट शेष कार्य = (75-40) = 35 यूनिट अमित + चेतन शेष कार्य 4 दिनों में करते हैं = 35/4 = 8 3/4 चेतन की कार्यक्षमता = 3 (3/4) = 15/4 चेतन द्वारा कार्य पूरा करने में लिया गया समय = 75/(15/4) = 20 दिन

t: A can do a work in 20 days, while B can do the same work in 25 days. They started the work jointly. Few days later C also joined them and thus all of them completed the whole work in 10 days. All of them were paid total of ₹700. What is the share of C?
e: Let A + B worked for = x days Then A + B + C worked for= [10 – x] days Total work completed by A and B in 10 days = 9×10 = 90 Remaining =100 90 =10 completed by C in 10 days Wages would be distributed according to work done A : B : C 50 ∶ 40 ∶ 10 = 5 : 4 : 1 Share of C= ×1=70₹

eh: मान लीजिए A + B ने = x दिन काम किया तो A + B + C ने = [10 – x] दिन काम किया A और B द्वारा दिन में पूरा किया गया कुल काम 10 है =9×10 = 90 शेष =100 – 90 =10 C द्वारा 10 दिन में पूरा किया गया मजदूरी किए गए काम के अनुसार वितरित की जाएगी A : B : C 50 ∶ 40 ∶ 10 = 5 : 4 : 1 C का हिस्सा = ×1=70₹

t: A can finish a piece of the work in 48 days and B can finish it in 36 days. They worked together for 15 days and then A B left. Find the time taken by A to finish the remaining work.
e:
The total work = L.C.M of 48 and 36 = 144
Efficiency = total work/ time taken
Efficiency of A = 144/ 48 = 3
Efficiency of B = 144/ 36 = 4
Work done in 15 days by A and B = 15 * 7 = 105
Work remaining = 144 - 105 = 39
Time taken by A to finish the remaining work = 39/ 3 = 13 days
h: A एक कार्य को 48 दिनों में पूरा कर सकता है और B इसे 36 दिनों में पूरा कर सकता है। उन्होंने 15 दिनों तक एक साथ कार्य किया और फिर B ने कार्य छोड़ दिया। शेष कार्य को पूरा करने में A द्वारा लिया गया समय ज्ञात कीजिए।

t: A can complete a piece of work alone in 200 days, while B can complete the same piece of work alone in 100 days. In every three-day cycle, both A and B work on day 1, only A works on day 2, and only B works on day 3. This cycle continues till the work is completed. How many days in all does it take the duo to complete the work?
e:
Total work = LCM of 200 and 100 = 200 units
Efficiency of A = 200/200 = 1 unit/day
Efficiency of B = 200/100 = 2 units/day
Total work in 3 days = (1 + 2) + 1 + 2 = 6 units
Total work in 99 days = 33 * 6 = 198 units
Remaining = 200 - 198 = 2 units
Total = 99 + 2/3 = 99(2/3) days
h: A अकेले किसी काम को 200 दिनों में पूरा कर सकता है, जबकि B अकेले उसी काम को 100 दिनों में पूरा कर सकता है। प्रत्येक तीन-दिवसीय चक्र में, A और B दोनों पहले दिन काम करते हैं, केवल A दूसरे दिन काम करता है, और केवल B तीसरे दिन काम करता है। यह चक्र तब तक चलता रहता है जब तक काम पूरा नहीं हो जाता। दोनों को काम पूरा करने में कुल कितने दिन लगते हैं?

t: In a research lab, five senior scientists, each equally efficient, can complete a complex analysis in 10 days. After 5 days, two juniors join at half a senior's efficiency each, and one senior leaves. How many days from that point are required to finish?
e:
Total work = 5 seniors X 10 days = 50 senior-days
Work done in first 5 days = 5 seniors X 5 days = 25 senior-days
Remaining = 50 - 25 = 25 senior-days
New team efficiency = 4 seniors X 1 + 2 juniors X 0.5 = 4 + 1 = 5 senior-equivalent units per day
Days needed = 25 ÷ 5 = 5 days
h: एक शोध प्रयोगशाला में, पाँच वरिष्ठ वैज्ञानिक, जिनमें से प्रत्येक समान रूप से कुशल है, एक जटिल विश्लेषण 10 दिनों में पूरा कर सकते हैं। 5 दिनों के बाद, दो कनिष्ठ वैज्ञानिक, प्रत्येक वरिष्ठ वैज्ञानिक की आधी दक्षता के साथ, प्रयोगशाला में शामिल होते हैं, और एक वरिष्ठ वैज्ञानिक प्रयोगशाला छोड़ देता है। इस बिंदु से, इसे पूरा करने में कितने दिन लगेंगे?

Money charged by worked B per day = 72/36 = Rs.2 per day

t: P can do a piece of work alone in 9 days, Q can do the same work alone in 18 days, while R can do it alone in 27 days. They work together and complete the work and receive a total of ₹726 as payment for doing the work. What is the combined share of Q and R, taken together from the above amount?
e:
We know, wages and time are inverse of each other.
Time ratio, P : Q : R = 9: 18: 27 = 1: 2: 3
Then, wages ratio, P : Q : R = (1/1): (1/2): (1/3) = 6: 3: 2
Total wages = ₹726
Therefore, share of Q and R together = 726 * (3 + 2)/(6 + 3 + 2) = ₹330

t: A worker increases his efficiency by 20% and completes a task of 120 units in 6 days. How many days would he have taken to complete the task at his original efficiency?
e: Let the original efficiency be 'r' Increased efficiency = 1.2r. Increased Rate = Work / Time => 1.2r = 120 / 6 = 20 units/day. Original efficiency r = 20 / 1.2 = 50/3 units/day. Time at original efficiency = 120 / (50/3) = 36/5 = 7.2 days.

joined them after 5 days from the beginning, then for how many days
did A work till the completion of the task?
e: A42B84C2884 213 Efficiency of A, B and C together = 2 + 1 + 3 = 6 A worked alone for 3 days = 2×3=6 Work done by A and B in 2 days = 3×2 = 6 Now work left is 84 - 6- 6 =72 A + B + C = =12 days A work for =12+3+2=17 days
h: A, B और C किसी काम को क्रमशः 42 दिन, 84 दिन और 28 दिन में पूरा कर सकते हैं। A ने काम शुरू किया। B 3 दिन बाद उसके साथ जुड़ गया। यदि C शुरू से 5 दिन बाद उनके साथ जुड़ गया, तो काम पूरा होने तक A ने कितने दिन काम किया?
eh: A42B84C2884 213 A, B और C की एक साथ कार्यदक्षता = 2 + 1 + 3 = 6 A ने अकेले 3 दिन काम किया = 2×3=6 A और B द्वारा 2 दिन में किया गया कार्य = 3×2 = 6 अब बचा काम 84 - 6- 6 =72 A + B + C = =12 दिन A ने =12+3+2=17 दिन काम किया

t: A, B, and C can complete a job in 8, 12, and 24 days individually. A, B and C respectively work on alternate days starting with A. How many days will it take in all?
e: Let the total work be LCM (8, 12, 24) = 24 units. Efficiency A = 3, B = 2, C = 1 unit/day. Work in one 3-day cycle = 3 + 2 + 1 = 6 units. Cycles needed = 24 / 6 = 4 cycles. Total days = 4 cycles X 3 days/cycle = 12 days.
h: A, B और C एक काम को अलग-अलग 8, 12 और 24 दिनों में पूरा कर सकते हैं। A, B और C क्रमशः A से शुरू करते हुए एकांतर दिनों पर काम करते हैं। इसमें कुल कितने दिन लगेंगे?

t: Benny can do a piece of work in 24 days. Chetan and David can do the same work individually in 36 and 48 days, respectively. All of them begin the work together. However, Benny leaves the work 4 days before the completion of work and Chetan leaves the work 10 days before the completion of the work. David worked till the end and completed the work. Find the number of days in which the work was completed.
e: Benny=24, Chetan=36, David=48. Total Work = 144. Eff: Benny=6, Chetan=4, David=3. Benny’s 4 days work = +24. Chetan’s 10 days work = +40. If they work till end -> 208 work. Time taken = 208 / (6+4+3) = 208/13 = 16 days
h: बेनी एक कार्य को 24 दिनों में कर सकता है। चेतन और डेविड एक ही कार्य को क्रमशः 36 और 48 दिनों में कर सकते हैं। वे सभी एक साथ कार्य शुरू करते हैं। हालांकि, बेनी कार्य पूरा होने से 4 दिन पहले और चेतन कार्य पूरा होने से 10 दिन पहले कार्य छोड़ देता है। डेविड ने अंत तक कार्य किया और कार्य पूरा किया। उन दिनों की संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए जिनमें दिनों में कार्य पूरा हुआ।

t: A college hostel mess has provisions for 25 days for 350 boys. At the end of 10 days, when some boys were shifted to another hostel, it was found now the provisions will last for 21 more days. How many boys were shifted to another hostel?
e:
Let the number of boys shifted to another hostel = n

Available provisions =25 ×350 = 8750

After 10 days, remaining provision = 8750 - 10 × 350 = 5250

Now, as per question,

[350 - n] 21 = 5250

350 - n = 250

n =100
h: एक कॉलेज हॉस्टल मेस में 350 लड़कों के लिए 25 दिनों का खाना है। 10 दिनों के अंत में, जब कुछ लड़कों को दूसरे हॉस्टल में स्थानांतरित कर दिया गया, तो पाया गया कि अब खाना 21 दिनों तक चलेगा। कितने लड़कों को दूसरे हॉस्टल में स्थानांतरित किया गया?

work = 100 unit

h: पाँच आदमी स्वतंत्र रूप से एक काम को 20 दिन में पूरा कर सकते हैं। काम एक व्यक्ति द्वारा शुरू किया जाता है। अगले दिन एक और व्यक्ति जुड़ता है और हर अगले दिन एक और व्यक्ति जुड़ता है। पाँचवें दिन से, पाँच व्यक्ति एक टीम के रूप में काम करना जारी रखते हैं। कितने दिनों में काम पूरा हो जाएगा?
eh:
माना एक व्यक्ति की कार्यकुशलता →5, दिन = 20
कुल कार्य = 100 इकाई
5 दिन में किया गया कार्य = 5+5×2+5×3……..5×5
5 दिन में = 75 इकाई कार्य किया गया
6वें दिन = 5 × 5=25 इकाई कार्य
अतः 100 इकाई कार्य पूरा करने में कुल 6 दिन लगेंगे

t: When A alone does a piece of work, he takes 25 days more than the time taken by A and B to do the work together. On the other hand, B alone takes 16 days more than the time taken by A and B to do the work together. How many days will A and B working together take to do the work?
e: Concept:- A alone -> x days more than (A+B) together. B alone -> y days more than (A+B) together. (A+B) working together = √(xy) days. A and B working together will complete the work = √(25 * 16) = 5 * 4 = 20 days.
h: जब A अकेले कोई कार्य करता है, तो उसे A और B द्वारा मिलकर कार्य करने में लिए गए समय से 25 दिन अधिक लगते हैं। दूसरी ओर, A और B द्वारा एक साथ काम करने के लिए गए समय से B अकेले 16 दिन अधिक लेता है। A और B को एक साथ काम करते हुए काम पूरा करने में कितने दिन लगेंगे?

t: A is 20% more efficient than B. How much time will they working together take to complete a job which A alone could have done in 29 days?
e:
A alone can complete the whole work in = 29 days
So, B alone can complete the whole work in = 29 * 120/100 = 174/5 days
Hence, both of them together can complete the whole work = 1/(1/29 + 5/174) = 174/11 days
h: A, B से 20% अधिक कार्य कुशल है। यदि A अकेला एक कार्य को 29 दिनों में पूरा कर सकता है, तो वे एक साथ कार्य करते हुए समान कार्य को पूरा करने में कितना समय लेंगे?

t: 28 women can complete a piece of work in 35 days while 60 boys can do the same work in 72 days and 20 girls can complete the same work in 80 days. In how many days the whole work can get completed by 49 women, 54 boys and 25 girls?
e:
Part of work done by 49 women, 54 boys and 25 girls in 1 day = 49/(28 * 35) + 54/(60 * 72) + 25/(20 * 80) = 5/64
So, 49 women, 54 boys and 25 girls together can complete the whole work in = 64/5 = 12.8 days
h: 28 महिलाएँ किसी कार्य को 35 दिनों में पूरा कर सकती हैं जबकि 60 लड़के समान कार्य को 72 दिनों में कर सकते हैं तथा 20 लड़कियाँ समान कार्य को 80 दिनों में पूरा कर सकती हैं। 49 महिलाएँ, 54 लड़के और 25 लड़कियों द्वारा संपूर्ण कार्य को कितने दिनों में पूरा किया जा सकता है?

t: Robert takes twice as much time as Tom and thrice as much time as George to complete a work. If working together, they can complete it in 23 hours, then find the time that Tom will take to complete the work.
e: Time ∝ 1/Efficiency. Time: Robert:Tom:George = 6:3:2. Eff: Robert:Tom:George = 1/6 : 1/3 : 1/2 = 1 : 2 : 3. Total work = (1+2+3) * 23 = 138 unit. Time taken by Tom to complete the work = 138/2 = 69 hours
h: रॉबर्ट को एक काम पूरा करने में टॉम से दोगुना और जॉर्ज से तीन गुना अधिक समय लगता है। यदि एक साथ काम करते हुए, वे इसे 23 घंटे में पूरा कर सकते हैं, तो टॉम को काम पूरा करने में कितना समय लगेगा?

t: 20 persons started a work together, but after some days, 8 persons leave. As a result, the job, which could have been completed in 80 days, was completed in 100 days. How many days after commencement of the work did the four persons leave?
e:
Let the number of days be X after which the four persons leave the work after commencement.
Total work = 20 * 80 units
Total work = [20X + 12(100 - X)] units
Now,
1600 = 20X + 1200 - 12X
400 = 8X
X = 50
h: 20 व्यक्तियों ने एक साथ एक काम शुरू किया, लेकिन कुछ दिनों के बाद 8 व्यक्ति काम छोड़ देते हैं। इसके फलस्वरूप, जो काम 80 दिन में पूरा हो सकता था, वह 100 दिन में पूरा हुआ। काम शुरू होने के कितने दिन बाद चारों व्यक्ति काम छोड़ देते हैं?

h: स्कूल A के 4 लड़के और स्कूल B के 6 लड़के मिलकर 5 दिन में एक प्रदर्शनी लगा सकते हैं, जबकि स्कूल A के 5 लड़के और स्कूल C के 10 लड़के मिलकर 4 दिन में या स्कूल B के 3 लड़के और स्कूल C के 4 लड़के मिलकर 10 दिन में प्रदर्शनी लगा सकते हैं। तो स्कूल A के कितने लड़के एक दिन में प्रदर्शनी लगा सकते हैं?
eh: [4A + 6B]5 = [5A + 10C]4 =[3B + 4C]10 20A + 30B = 20A + 40C = 30B + 40C 20A + 30B = 20A + 40C ⇒ B : C = 4 : 3 कुल कार्य = 30 × 4 + 40 × 3 =240 20A + 30B = 240 ⇒ 20A = 120; A = 6 A को = = 40 दिन लगते हैं

t: A and B can do a project in 15 days. B and C can do it in 12 days while C and A can do it in 20 days. In how many days A, B and C all working together can finish 80% of the project?
e: A+B→15B+C→12C+A→2060 So, Efficiency of A+B, B+C & C+A is 4, 5 & 3 respectively. Efficiency of A+B+C = (4 + 5 + 3)/2 =6 A + B + C can complete 80% of the work = (60/6) × (4/5) = 8 days
h: A और B एक प्रोजेक्ट को 15 दिनों में पूरा कर सकते हैं। B और C इसे 12 दिनों में पूरा कर सकते हैं जबकि C और A इसे 20 दिनों में पूरा कर सकते हैं। A, B और C सभी एक साथ मिलकर प्रोजेक्ट का 80% कितने दिनों में पूरा कर सकते हैं?
eh: इसलिए, A+B, B+C और C+A की कार्यदक्षता क्रमशः 4, 5 और 3 है। A+B+C की कार्यदक्षता = (4 + 5 + 3)/2 = 6 A + B + C कार्य का 80% पूरा कर सकते हैं = (60/6) × (4/5) = 8 दिन

t: Suresh and Anil are working on a special project. Suresh takes 5 hours to type 40 pages and Anil needs 6 hours to type 32 pages on a computer. How much time will it take them to type a 110-page assignment if they work on two different computers?
e: Suresh 40/5 = 8 page/hr. Anil 32/6 = 16/3 page/hr. Together they will type = 8 + 16/3 = 40/3 page/hr. Time taken to type 110 page = 110 / (40/3) = (110*3)/40 = 33/4 Hours = 8 hours 15 min

t: Amita can build a room in the same amount of time that Bina and Sita working together can build. If Amita and Bina together could do it in 25 days and Sita alone in 35 days, then how many days are required for Bina alone to do the same work?
e: A = B+S => A: (B+S) eff = 1:1. A+B=25, S=35. Total Work = 175. Eff: A+B=7, S=5. Total eff (A+B+S) = 12. So A = 6, B+S=6. Since S=5, B=1. Bina will complete work in 175/1 = 175 days
h: अमिता एक कमरा उतने ही समय में बना सकती है जितने समय में बीना और सीता मिलकर बना सकती हैं। यदि अमिता और बीना मिलकर इसे 25 दिनों में बना सकती हैं और सीता अकेले 35 दिनों में, तो बीना को अकेले उसी काम को करने में कितने दिन लगेंगे?

t: A civil contractor planned to build an over bridge of 3 km distance in 600 days. For this purpose, he employed 90 workers. After 200 days of work, it was observed that only 0.5 km of the bridge was completed. What is the number of extra workers required to complete the work in time?
e: Remaining work = 3 - 0.5 = 2.5 Remaining days = 600 - 200 = 400 Let the number of extra workers required = m According to the question- m + 90 = m + 90 = 225 m = 225 - 90 m = 135

t: To do a work together, A and B got Rs.924 as wages in total. What is the share of A if he is 4/3 times as efficient as B?
e: We know, wages are distributed in the proportion of efficiency. Efficiency ratio = wages ratio = A: B = 4: 3 Total wages = Rs.924 Therefore, share of A = 924 * 4/(4 + 3) = Rs.528

t: A factory has two machines M1 and M2. M1 can produce 120 units in 8 hours, and M2 produces 150 units in 10 hours. Working together on a single batch, how many hours will they take to produce 300 units?
e:
Let r1 = rate of M1 = 120/8 = 15 units/hour
Let r2 = rate of M2 = 150/10 = 15 units/hour
Combined rate = 15 + 15 = 30 units/hour
Time to produce 300 units = 300/30 = 10 hours
h: एक कारखाने में दो मशीनें M1 और M2 हैं। M1, 8 घंटे में 120 इकाइयाँ बना सकती है और M2, 10 घंटे में 150 इकाइयाँ बना सकती है। एक ही बैच पर साथ मिलकर काम करने पर, उन्हें 300 इकाइयाँ बनाने में कितने घंटे लगेंगे?

t: Sudarshan can copy 50 pages in 10 hours; Sudarshan and Prakash together can copy 300 pages in 40 hours. In how much time can Prakash copy 25 pages?
e: Sudarshan's efficiency = 50 page / 10 hour = 5 page/hour Sudarshan + Prabhash = 300 page / 40 hour = 7.5 page / hour Prabhash's efficiency = (7.5-5) = 2.5 page / hour
h: सुदर्शन 10 घंटे में 50 पेज कॉपी कर सकता है; सुदर्शन और प्रकाश मिलकर 40 घंटे में 300 पेज कॉपी कर सकते हैं। प्रकाश 25 पेज कितने समय में कॉपी कर सकता है?
eh:
सुदर्शन की कार्यक्षमता = 50 पृष्ठ / 10 घंटे = 5 पृष्ठ/घंटा


सुदर्शन + प्रभाष = 300 पृष्ठ / 40 घंटे = 7.5 पृष्ठ/घंटा


प्रभाष की कार्यक्षमता = (7.5-5) = 2.5 पृष्ठ/घंटा

e: 1M = 2W = 4B = 5G = 20 (LCM). M:W:B:G = 20:10:5:4. Total work = 20 * 39. Time taken by 1 men, 1 women, 1 Boy and 1 Girl = (2039) / (20+10+5+4) = (2039)/39 = 20 days.

t: A contractor employs 15 men to complete a work in 24 days, working 8 hours per day. If all men work with the same efficiency throughout, how many more days will be required to finish the remaining work?
e:

Let it taken 'x' days from 7th day to complete the work
15×8×6 + 20×6×x = 2880
720 + 120x = 2880
120x = 2160
x = 2160/120 = 18 days

t: Instructions: Evaluate the following statements to determine if the information provided is sufficient to answer the question. Question: If P, Q, and R work together, how many days will they take to complete a project? Statement I: Q and R together can complete the project in 10 days. Statement II: P and R together can complete the project in 15 days.
o: Statement I alone provides enough information to answer the question, but Statement Il alone does not.
Statement Il alone provides enough information to answer the question, but Statement I alone does not.
Both Statement I and Statement II combined are needed to answer the question, as neither statement on its own is sufficient.
Even when combined, the information in both Statement I and Statement Il is not enough to answer the question.

प्रश्न: यदि P, Q और R मिलकर काम करते हैं, तो उन्हें एक प्रोजेक्ट पूरा करने में कितने दिन लगेंगे?


कथन I: Q और R मिलकर प्रोजेक्ट को 10 दिनों में पूरा कर सकते हैं।


कथन II: P और R मिलकर प्रोजेक्ट को 15 दिनों में पूरा कर सकते हैं।
oh: केवल कथन I ही प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त जानकारी प्रदान करता है, लेकिन केवल कथन II नहीं।
केवल कथन II ही प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त जानकारी प्रदान करता है, जबकि केवल कथन I नहीं।
इस प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए कथन I और कथन II, दोनों को मिलाकर आवश्यकता है, क्योंकि इनमें से कोई भी कथन अपने आप में पर्याप्त नहीं है।
दोनों कथनों I और II में दी गई जानकारी को मिलाने पर भी, प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए वह पर्याप्त नहीं है।

Q + 2R + P = 5

अतः, I और II दोनों मिलकर भी पर्याप्त नहीं हैं।

One day's earning of 11 women + 9 men = 11(200)+9(120) = 2200+1080 = 3280. For 13 days: 3280×13 = 42640. Always reduce multi-day totals to a "per day" rate first before scaling to the new number of days/people — that's the core technique for all such questions.
